responsibility: Defines the static target description macros for the Xstormy16 port: driver/link specs, preprocessor builtins, data layout and type sizes, register file and register classes, calling convention registers, stack and frame layout, argument passing and return rules, addressing capabilities, section/assembler syntax, debug format settings, and other machine properties consumed by GCC’s generic backend. It is the architectural configuration header that describes what the target looks like, while stormy16.cc provides the procedural hook implementations.
same_name_distinction: Provides the static target-description header for the Stormy16 port: preprocessor, ABI, register, stack, addressing, section, and assembler-interface macros consumed by GCC and by stormy16.cc. Unlike stormy16.cc, it does not implement hook logic or emit RTL/assembly procedurally; unlike stormy16.md, it is not the RTL instruction-pattern file; unlike stormy16.opt, it defines machine properties rather than target switches.
